title: ר' סימון (בן זבדי)
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: (a) Brother of R. Yehudah ben Zavdi; see above, Abba bar Zavda. When R. Simon bar Zevid died, Leya—that is Ila—entered and eulogized him, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 2, mishnah 8. End of HaYashen: in R. Ila's name; Pesaḥim, HaIshah: before R. Ila. R. Ḥizkiyah and R. Pinḥas in R. Simon bar Zavdi's name, Kohelet Rabbah, 'I said in my heart, I shall try joy'; R. Yonah in his name, there. R. Simon bar Zavdi asked before R. Yose, Jerusalem Talmud, Shevi’it 2, halakhah 8 [printed locator; passage at 2:5:9]. R. Pinḥas: see above. In Rav's name, Bereshit Rabbah, Vayeshev, end of 85. Jerusalem Talmud, Asarah Yuḥasin, halakhah 2, has 'R. Abba, R. Yehudah bar Zavdi's brother': a scribal error, since Bava Batra, beginning of Ḥezkat HaBatim, has R. Simon, R. Yehudah's brother. R. Shemuel bar Naḥmani, beginning of Mi SheHayah Tame; R. Shemuel bar Naḥman, Nedarim 6, halakhah 13 [printed locator; passage at 6:8:7]. I am uncertain whether unqualified R. Simon is ben Zavdi.

(b) R. Abba, Shevi'it 6. In R. Avdimi of Haifa's name. R. Aḥa. R. Aḥa bar Shalki. R. Ila (see above). In R. Inyai bar Sisi's name. He and R. Elazar sat as R. Yaakov bar Aḥa passed, Shabbat, BaMeh Madlikin 31b. R. Ammi said: R. Yoḥanan said, Ketubbot 31a. R. Zeira told R. Simon to rebuke the exilarch's household, Shabbat 55a. R. Ḥizkiyah (see above). In Ḥilfaya's name, Shevi'it 6. R. Ḥilkiyah in his name. R. Yehudah Gezorah. R. Yehudah ben Pazi. In R. Yehoshua's name (see Taddai). R. Yehoshua of Sikhnin in his name. R. Yehoshua bar Evyon. In R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name, Arakhin 16a; Bava Kamma 115b. R. Yoḥanan of Jaffa in his time. R. Yonah (see above). In R. Yonatan of Beit Guvrin's name. In R. Yose son of R. Nehorai's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot 1. He asked R. Yose (see above). R. Yaakov bar Aḥa (see above). In R. Peda's name; in R. Pedayah's name, end of Terumot 4. R. Pinḥas (see above). R. Pinḥas bar Ḥama in Rav's name (see above). In R. Shemuel bar Naḥman's name (see above). In Resh Lakish's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Keitzad Mevarekhin, mishnah 7; Eikhah Rabbah at 'From the daughter of Zion went out.' In R. Shimon Nezira's name; in R. Shimon bar Abba's name. R. Taddai in R. Yehoshua's name.
